correctness.rationale: For δ(z)=min(1-|z1|,1-|z2|), layer-cake integration of the true coupled boundary-distance weight gives ||z1^j z2^k||²=m!(2j+2k+4)!/[(j+1)(k+1)(2j+2k+m+4)!]. Angular monomials are complete and orthogonal, so the kernel series and G_{m+1}=(2u∂u+2v∂v+m+5)G_m follow. K0 is the nonvanishing product; K1 numerator 5-u-v-3uv has no zeros for |u|,|v|<1 by |5-u|>|1+3u|. Restricting cross products u=v=x gives K_m(x,x)=P_m(x)/(1-x)^(m+4) with recurrence (m+1)P_{m+1}=2x(1-x)P_m'+[(m+5)+(m+3)x]P_m. Coefficient positivity, derivative sign alternation at the simple negative roots, the root between the rightmost old root and zero, and extra left root when degree grows establish all-negative simple interlacing for every integer m. P2=15+22x+3x² has x2=(-11+2√19)/3 in (-1,0); rightmost roots move to zero, giving actual off-diagonal zeros for each m≥2. Independent exact P2 recurrence and coordinate root checks agree; finite tests do not replace induction.
